name: Ursal the Mauler
summary: In Teldrassil, Athridas Bearmantle seeks to wake the Druids of the Talon from their unnatural sleep. Their kin remain trapped in the Barrow Den, and the corrupted Gnarlpine chief behind the disturbance must be slain.

sections.title: A Slumber Turned Nightmare
sections.body: The Druids of the Talon withdrew to the Barrow Den of Ban'ethil to sleep and commune with the Emerald Dream. Their peaceful trance became a prison with no way back to waking. Athridas Bearmantle traced the trouble to the gnarlpine furbolgs, and to their vicious leader, Ursal the Mauler, who meddled with the druids' sacred ritual. The sleepers remain caught between waking and the Dream.

sections.title: The Den in Gnarlpine Hold
sections.body: Athridas needs more than the Relics of Wakening to reach the druids through the spiritual fog. The source of the interference must be ended. Ursal the Mauler makes his lair in Gnarlpine Hold, the tribe's home in far southwestern Teldrassil. Striking down the furbolg warlord breaks his hold on the sleepers' minds.

sections.title: A Symptom of Deeper Rot
sections.body: Athridas can perform the ritual and rescue the Druids of the Talon once Ursal is dead, but Teldrassil's sickness remains. The Gnarlpine tribe is still maddened by corruption, and no one knows what is spreading through the World Tree's boughs.

aliases: who is the boss in gnarlpine hold
faq.answer: Ursal the Mauler leads the corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs from Gnarlpine Hold in southwestern Teldrassil. His meddling with the Druids of the Talon's reverie trapped them in their Barrow Den slumber.

faq.q: Why must Ursal be killed to awaken the druids?
aliases: why does ursal need to die
faq.answer: Athridas Bearmantle has the Relics of Wakening, but his ritual cannot reach the druids while Ursal lives. The furbolg's interference anchors them in slumber and keeps their spirits from returning to their bodies.

faq.q: Where can Ursal the Mauler be found?
faq.answer: Ursal makes his lair in Gnarlpine Hold, the Gnarlpine tribe's home in far southwestern Teldrassil.

faq.q: Does killing Ursal completely save the Gnarlpine furbolgs?
faq.answer: No. Ursal's death frees the sleeping druids, but the Gnarlpine furbolgs remain corrupted, and sickness continues to spread through Teldrassil's forests.

faq.q: Who are the Druids of the Talon?
faq.answer: The Druids of the Talon are night elf druids devoted to the crow totem, and they can take the form of storm crows. They entered deep slumber in the Barrow Den to watch over the wilds from within the Emerald Dream.
Athridas Bearmantle is a night elf druid stationed in Dolanaar. He sends adventurers to recover stolen relics and slay Ursal so his brethren can wake safely.

angles.text: The Gnarlpine furbolgs were once ancient allies of the kaldorei. Slaying their maddened leader, Ursal, is a sorrowful necessity to protect your kin and the sleeping druids.
As a druid, you know the sacred rites of the Emerald Dream must be preserved. Ursal's meddling with the Druids of the Talon profanes Cenarion communion.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Teldrassil's interior roads and restore its circle of druids, strengthening the night elves' stronghold as they join the wider Alliance.
